## Mature-first gate

For any new algorithm, model, UI primitive, or workflow:

- [ ] I searched for maintained mature implementations first.
- [ ] I inspected actual source/API, not only screenshots or descriptions.
- [ ] License and model-weight redistribution terms were checked.
- [ ] I am directly reusing/vendoring an existing implementation where practical.
- [ ] Any custom algorithm/UI primitive has a written gap analysis and explicit approval.
- [ ] A small real-data benchmark exists before full integration.
- [ ] Acceptance and stop/go metrics are defined.
- [ ] Packaging/installer/large UI work is deferred until the candidate passes.
- [ ] Dependency/model download cost is staged and justified.

## What is reused

Describe the upstream implementation(s), exact API/files/models reused, and any local adaptation.

## Validation

Describe the smallest real-data test and pass/fail criteria.
